## What's new

- **Your agents can use attached BigBrain vaults.** Squad agents automatically get read tools for vaults their squad can access. Managers and consultants can also save notes through the local BigBrain connection; shared vaults remain read-only for agents.
- **See what an agent is monitoring.** Active monitors appear in a highlighted row in the agent's chat. Click a monitor's name to see its details, and agents keep watching without idle-work reminders interrupting them.
- **Open results straight from chat.** Completed tool calls offer shortcuts to questions, artifacts, apps, memory notes, and newly created pull requests and work streams. The shortcuts stay visible under collapsed tool groups, and missing targets get a clear notice.
- **Questions are harder to miss.** The squad Chats list marks agents with pending questions, and the question card uses a clearer attention color. Reply suggestions now float over the transcript rather than taking up a separate strip.
- **Send multi-line responses.** Work stream input requests and review send-backs accept pasted logs and longer answers. Enter inserts a newline; Command+Enter or Control+Enter submits.
- **More room for your Assistant conversation.** Earlier conversation now lives at the top of the scrolling transcript instead of a fixed panel. Reading older messages keeps your place when new replies arrive, and archive loading shows progress with a Retry button if it fails.
- **Download larger workspace files.** Workspace downloads stream rather than loading the whole file into memory. The CLI adds resumable downloads and tar.gz directory archives.
- **Easier event-rule editing.** New integration event rules appear at the top and scroll into view. A Reset to default rules button lets you restore the defaults before saving.
- **Clearer BigBrain vault settings.** Shared vaults use their Ficus name in BigBrain, deleted vaults disappear from squad settings, and the shared-vault section explains the server's two-vault limit. Joining a vault is more reliable when the gateway is busy.
- **Smaller fixes.** Hover menus open faster, work stream numbers in agent rows open in place, theme and Settings icons have more consistent styling, and inline text controls fit better on small screens.
